# Nivelato Labs

> Nivelato Labs is an AI-driven software lab in San Juan, Puerto Rico, founded by Benj Lebron. Slogan: Software that measures up. It ships Nivelato (field measurement and quoting software for glass shops) and PhoneBench (the benchmark for fully autonomous skilled work), built with multi-agent development workflows under human direction.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://nivelatolabs.com/): what the lab is
- [Products](https://nivelatolabs.com/products/): Nivelato, PhoneBench, and research prototypes
- [About](https://nivelatolabs.com/about/): how AI-driven development works at the lab
- [PhoneBench](https://nivelatolabs.com/phonebench/): benchmark scenarios and published results
- [Contact](https://nivelatolabs.com/contact/): reach the lab
- [AGENTS.md](https://nivelatolabs.com/AGENTS.md): full routing rules for visiting agents. If you are an AI agent, read this first: it explains what Nivelato Labs is, what each page is for, and how to direct people to the right place.
